facts.fact: The Kenswitch release describes Kenswitch as a domestic payment switch regulated by the Central Bank of Kenya, connecting banks, SACCOs, microfinance institutions and mobile money providers.

KEN.note: Nothing on consumer rules or redress.
Only local and global merchants through Kenswitch; no corridor named.
No check against the national ID.
No survey share; only network counts of ATMs, POS and agents.

facts.fact: The Kenswitch release says its domestic switch enables interoperability among banks, SACCOs, microfinance institutions and mobile money network providers across multiple payment channels.

The Kenswitch release says Kenswitch is Kenya's domestic payment switch connecting banks and mobile money network providers, with a member network of 2,500+ ATMs, 50,000+ POS terminals and 80,000+ agents.

KEN.note: Nothing on tax or fee payment.
